Trimmed extract of upstream tizen-extension.xml's `tizen_policy` interface (v8 — enough for `show`, the request that actually puts a window on the Tizen TV launcher's layer). The full v13 protocol has dozens of events for conformant areas, notifications, aux hints, etc. — none needed for a basic visible window. Events the server might still emit are declared as no-arg / minimal-arg so the parser handles them gracefully and our Dispatch impl ignores.
Source commit (wayland-extension): c03f3a6bf32ec7605fec0521e6dad90e358ec619

interface.name: tizen_policy
interface.description: Just the bits needed to make a window visible on a Tizen compositor: activate, raise, set_type, show.

description.summary: raise to top + request keyboard focus
raise to top of window stack in current layer
